parent_objective: audit no-rollout bounded calibration smoke subset before execution design
blocked_by: need audit before bounded calibration smoke execution design
supersedes: direct bounded calibration smoke execution after M1705

public_gates: M1706 must audit M1705 subset counts source/task/profile coverage contract checks and guardrails
M1706 must decide whether bounded calibration smoke execution design is admitted
M1706 must not execute rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1706 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the bounded smoke subset before execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if subset count is not 864 cells
stop if task/source/profile/calibration coverage is incomplete
stop if audit routes directly to profile ranking
fallback_plan: route to bounded execution design if subset is clean
route to subset repair if coverage or contract checks fail
route to branch synthesis if the subset cannot support task-quality diagnosis

admission_evidence: M1705 writes bounded subset artifacts and summary
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1706 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded execution design manifest
next_stage_criteria: subset artifacts and coverage are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1706 audits infrastructure only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows for later bounded smoke
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the subset is invalid, route to repair before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1705 can be audited as a clean no-rollout bounded calibration smoke preflight and routed to execution design.
success_criteria: next bounded execution design route is explicit
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to profile ranking
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1705 bounded smoke subset artifacts and write next-route decision

decision_rule: M1706 passes if it audits M1705 and routes to bounded calibration smoke execution design or repair without overclaiming.
